```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(labelled)
library(synthpop)
library(mice)
library(miceadds)
library(sdcMicro)
library(tictoc)
```

```{r read data into r}
# Get accesss for the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP-CORE) first, then read the pgen, hgen and pequiv data set
pgen <- readRDS("~/Desktop/Bachelorarbeit/R_DE/pgen.rds")
hgen <- readRDS("~/Desktop/Bachelorarbeit/R_DE/hgen.rds")
pequiv <- readRDS("~/Desktop/Bachelorarbeit/R_DE/pequiv.rds")
```

```{r SOEP reduce data to first wave due to its size}
pgen <- pgen %>% dplyr::filter(syear == 1984)
hgen <- hgen %>% dplyr::filter(syear == 1984)
pequiv <- pequiv %>% dplyr::filter(syear == 1984)
```

```{r unlabel data and convert missing values into NA}
pgen <- remove_val_labels(pgen)
pgen[pgen < 0] <- NA

hgen <- remove_val_labels(hgen)
# missing conventions into NA as stated here: https://paneldata.org/soep-core/
hgen[hgen < 0] <- NA

pequiv <- remove_val_labels(pequiv)
# missing conventions into NA as stated here: https://paneldata.org/soep-core/
pequiv[pequiv < 0] <- NA

##########
# Remove variables, that contain only NA values (although this is probably only the case because of excluding other waves)

# for finding out, which variables are removed in pgen, hgen, health and pequiv respectively:
names(which(!(colSums(is.na(pgen)) != nrow(pgen))))
names(which(!(colSums(is.na(hgen)) != nrow(hgen))))
names(which(!(colSums(is.na(pequiv)) != nrow(pequiv))))

# for removing them
pgen <- pgen[, colSums(is.na(pgen)) != nrow(pgen)]
hgen <- hgen[, colSums(is.na(hgen)) != nrow(hgen)]
pequiv <- pequiv[, colSums(is.na(pequiv)) != nrow(pequiv)]
```

``` {r data synthesis}
tic()
synth_pgen <- syn(pgen, seed = 123, minnumlevels = 10)
synth_hgen <- syn(hgen, seed = 123, minnumlevels = 10)
synth_pequiv <- syn(pequiv, seed = 123, minnumlevels = 10)
toc()
```

```{r data preperation}
# original data
data_full <- pgen %>% 
  inner_join(pequiv, by = "pid", suffix=c("",".y")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  inner_join(hgen, by = "hid", suffix=c("",".y")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) 

# synthetic data, if first synthesized and then merged
synth_data <- synth_pgen$syn %>%
  inner_join(synth_pequiv$syn, by = "pid", suffix=c("",".y")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  inner_join(synth_hgen$syn, by = "hid", suffix=c("",".y")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y"))

# synthetic data, if first merged then synthesized
tic()
synth_data_full <- syn(data_full, seed = 123, minnumlevels = 10)
toc()
```

```{r Global Utilities}
Util_hgen <- utility.gen(synth_hgen, hgen)
```

``` {r Multiple Imputation of data sets}
# Take Methods and predictor matrix from synthpop step above
meth <- synth_data_full$method
# remove collinear methods for collinear variables
meth <- str_remove_all(meth, pattern = "collinear")
pred <- synth_data_full$predictor.matrix
# include models into prediction matrix, which will be analyzed later
# Happiness/Life satisfaction
pred["p11101", ] <- 0
pred["p11101", c("d11104", "pglabgro", "pgvebzeit", "e11101", "pgemplst", "hghinc")] <- 1
# Health
pred["m11125", ] <- 0
pred["m11125", c("d11101", "d11104", "m11127", "m11102")] <- 1
# Household Income
pred["hghinc", ] <- 0
pred["hghinc", c("d11104", "d11109", "d11102ll")] <- 1

#### BEWARE: The following three mice imputation functions take a long while to compile
# for original data
tic()
imputed_data <- mice(data_full, method = meth, predictorMatrix = pred, seed = 123, 
maxit = 10, m = 5)

# for synthetic data, if first synthesized then merged
test <- syn(synth_data, m=0)
imputed_data_syn <- mice(synth_data, method = test$method, predictorMatrix = pred, seed = 123, 
maxit = 10, m = 5)

# for synthetic data, if first merged then synthesized
imputed_data_full_syn <- mice(synth_data_full$syn, method = meth, predictorMatrix = pred, seed = 123, 
maxit = 10, m = 5)
toc()
```

``` {r confidence interval function}
# Function to calculate the Confidence Interval Overlap using the confidence invervals returned by the regression models.
# Idea of this approach taken from compare.CI function at bottom of website:
# https://rdrr.io/cran/synthpop/src/R/compare.syn.r#sym-compare.fit.synds
# Input: 
#   confint_orig: confidence interval of the regression analysis on the original dataset as a two column dataframe
#   confint_orig: confidence interval of the regression analysis on the synthetic dataset as a two column dataframe
# Output: A one column dataframe containing the confidence interval overlaps for each predictor of the analysi

CI.Overlap <- function(confint_orig, confint_syn) {
  #since both models take in same variables, contint_orig and confint_syn have same dimension
  CIoverlap <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(confint_orig), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(rownames(confint_orig), "CI overlap"))
  ##Calculate CIoverlap
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(confint_orig))) {  
    ## CI overlap
    overlap.lower <- max(confint_orig[i, 1], confint_syn[i, 1])       
    overlap.upper <- min(confint_orig[i, 2], confint_syn[i, 2])       
    
    CIoverlap[i, 1] <- 0.5 * 
      (((overlap.upper - overlap.lower) / (confint_orig[i, 2] - confint_orig[i, 1])) + 
         ((overlap.upper - overlap.lower) / (confint_syn[i, 2] - confint_syn[i, 1])))
    
    }
  return(as.data.frame(CIoverlap))
}
```

```{r analyses on the imputed original and synthetic datasets for Life Satisfaction}
# # LIFE SATISFACTION (happyness scale from 0 - 10)
# overall life satisfaction pequiv$p11101
# marital status pequiv$d11104 or also pgen$pgfamstd
# current gross labor income in euro pgen$pglabgro
# agreed upon time at work pgen$pgvebzeit
# annual workhours of individual pequiv$e11101
# employment status pgen$pgemplst(non-binary) or pequiv$e11102(binary)
# monthly household net income in euro hgen$hghinc

# original dataset
fit <- with(imputed_data, expr = lm(p11101 ~ as.factor(d11104) + pglabgro + pgvebzeit + e11101 + as.factor(pgemplst) + hghinc))
pool <- pool(fit)
summary_pool <- summary(pool, conf.int = TRUE)

# synthetic dataset (first synthesized then merged)
fit_syn <- with(imputed_data_syn, expr = lm(p11101 ~ as.factor(d11104) + pglabgro + pgvebzeit + e11101 + as.factor(pgemplst) + hghinc))
pool_syn <- pool(fit_syn)
summary_pool_syn <- summary(pool_syn, conf.int = TRUE)

# synthetic dataset (first merged then synthesized)
fit_syn_full <- with(imputed_data_full_syn, expr = lm(p11101 ~ as.factor(d11104) + pglabgro + pgvebzeit + e11101 + as.factor(pgemplst) + hghinc))
pool_syn_full <- pool(fit_syn_full)
summary_pool_syn_full <- summary(pool_syn_full, conf.int = TRUE)

# for CI Overlap
confint_orig <- summary_pool[c(7,8)]
rownames(confint_orig) <- as.character(summary_pool[[1]])

confint_syn <- summary_pool_syn[c(7,8)]
rownames(confint_syn) <- as.character(summary_pool_syn[[1]])

confint_syn_full <- summary_pool_syn_full[c(7,8)]
rownames(confint_syn_full) <- as.character(summary_pool_syn_full[[1]])

# results of model and Confidence Overlap
summary_pool #original
summary_pool_syn #syn first synthesized
summary_pool_syn_full #syn first merged
CI.Overlap(confint_orig = confint_orig, confint_syn = confint_syn) #CIoverlap of original and synthetic(first synthesized)
CI.Overlap(confint_orig = confint_orig, confint_syn = confint_syn_full) #CIoverlap of original and synthetic(first merged)
```

``` {r risk assessment fully synthetic data}
# check if there are duplicates from the original into the synthetic dataset
#pgen
intersect(pgen, synth_pgen$syn) #0
#hgen
intersect(hgen, synth_hgen$syn) #0
#pequiv
intersect(pequiv, synth_pequiv$syn) #0
#full data
intersect(data_full, synth_data_full$syn) #0

#### examine via l-diversity

# Function to bundle steps taken by me to get the k-anonymity l-diversity by first creating object of class sdcMicroObj.
# Input:
#   data: dataframe containing the microdataset, which shall be analyzed
#   selected_keyVars: character vector containing names of chategorical key variables
#   selected_numVars: character vector containing names of numeric key variables
#   selected_sensibleVars: character vector containing names of sensible variables for l-diversity
#   weight: character scalar containing sampling weights
# Output:
#   prints outputs for k-anonymity, l-diversity measures and the first few rows of the l-diversity output
getLDiversity <- function(data, selected_keyVars, selected_numVars, selected_sensibleVars = NULL, weight = NULL) {
  data_sdc <- data
  data_sdc[, selected_keyVars] <- lapply(data_sdc[, selected_keyVars], factor) #categorical variables to factor
  data_sdc <- data_sdc[, c(selected_keyVars, selected_numVars, selected_sensibleVars)] #subset
  SdcObj_data <- createSdcObj(data_sdc, keyVars = selected_keyVars, numVars = selected_numVars, 
                              sensibleVar = selected_sensibleVars)
  if (!is.null(selected_sensibleVars)) {
    SdcObj_data <- ldiversity(SdcObj_data) 
    print(SdcObj_data)# k-anonymity for 2, 3 and 5 anonymity
    print(SdcObj_data@risk$ldiversity) #l-diversity measures ( Min., 1st Qu., Median, Mean 3rd Qu., Max.)
    head(SdcObj_data@risk$ldiversity) 
  #Distinct_Ldiversity, Entropy_Ldiversity, Recursive_Ldiversity, MultiEntropy_Ldiversity, MultiRecursive_Ldiversity
  } else {
    print(SdcObj_data)# k-anonymity for 2, 3 and 5 anonymity
  }
}

#pgen original and synthetic
selected_keyVars1 <- c("pgfamstd", "pgstib", "pgemplst", "pgjobch", "pgnace", "pgisco88", "pgkldb92", "pgausb", "pgpsbil")
selected_numVars1 <- c("pglabnet", "pgerwzeit", "pguebstd", "pgbilzeit")
selected_sensibleVars1 <- c("pgnation")

getLDiversity(data = pgen, selected_keyVars = selected_keyVars1, selected_numVars = selected_numVars1, 
              selected_sensibleVars = selected_sensibleVars1)

getLDiversity(data = synth_pgen$syn, selected_keyVars = selected_keyVars1, selected_numVars = selected_numVars1, 
              selected_sensibleVars = selected_sensibleVars1)

#hgen original and synthetic

              selected_sensibleVars = selected_sensibleVars2)

              selected_sensibleVars = selected_sensibleVars2)

              selected_numVars = selected_numVars_full, selected_sensibleVars = selected_sensibleVars_full,
```
